products.name: Lenders Protection Platform (LPP)
products.description: A cloud-based automotive lending enablement platform that provides risk-based pricing, real-time underwriting, and integration with insurance partners to offer default insurance for near-prime and non-prime automotive loans. Delivered digitally to automotive lenders and integrates with their loan origination systems.

products.name: ApexOne Auto Platform
products.description: A cloud-based decisioning platform for automotive lenders to support loans made to prime borrowers, using proprietary risk-based pricing models and data analytics, but without default insurance. Delivered digitally to lenders and integrates with their systems.

products.name: Claims Administration Services for Auto Loan Default Insurance
products.description: Administration of claims on auto loan default insurance policies for insurance partners, including claims processing and customer service. Requires licensed personnel and is delivered as a service to insurance partners.

products.name: Retail Electricity Supply
products.description: Provision of electricity to residential, commercial, industrial, and wholesale customers across North America, delivered via owned and contracted generation assets and market purchases, under fixed, indexed, or variable pricing contracts.

products.name: Retail Natural Gas Supply
products.description: Provision of natural gas to residential, commercial, industrial, and wholesale customers, utilizing a portfolio of supply, transportation, and storage assets, with contracts ranging from spot to multi-year terms.

products.name: Smart Home Solutions
products.description: Integrated smart home technology platform (Vivint Smart Home) offering hardware, software, installation, monitoring, and support for home automation, security, and energy management, delivered via in-home professionals and a cloud-based platform.

products.name: Demand Response and Virtual Power Plant Services
products.description: Programs and platforms (including CPower) that aggregate and manage customer load and distributed energy resources to provide grid services, reduce costs, and improve reliability, primarily for commercial, industrial, and large-load customers.

products.name: Wholesale Power Generation and Capacity Sales
products.description: Operation and sale of electricity and capacity from a diversified fleet of owned and managed power plants (natural gas, coal, oil, and renewables) to wholesale markets, utilities, and other intermediaries, including participation in capacity and ancillary services markets.

products.name: Smart Home Security and Monitoring Services
products.description: Professional monitoring, installation, and support for home security systems, including cameras, sensors, and emergency response, integrated with smart home automation and delivered via Vivint Smart Home.

products.name: Energy Management and Efficiency Solutions
products.description: Services and products for commercial and industrial customers to optimize energy usage, including energy efficiency, distributed and backup generation, energy storage, carbon management, and renewable/low-carbon product offerings.

products.name: Physical and Financial Commodity Trading
products.description: Trading of power, natural gas, environmental, weather, and other commodity products (forwards, futures, options, swaps) to manage price and delivery risk, optimize assets, and comply with regulations, conducted in wholesale markets.

products.name: Operations and Maintenance Services for Third-Party Generation Assets
products.description: Operation and maintenance of coal, natural gas, and wind generation facilities owned by third parties, using industry best practices for safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: NLRP3 Inhibitor Therapeutics (BGE-102)
products.description: Orally available, brain-penetrant small-molecule NLRP3 inhibitors developed for the treatment of chronic cardiometabolic diseases (such as atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease) and ophthalmic diseases (such as diabetic macular edema and geographic atrophy). These therapeutics are discovered and optimized through proprietary molecular screening and are delivered as oral pharmaceuticals, requiring regulated clinical development and manufacturing.

products.name: Apelin Receptor (APJ) Agonist Therapeutics
products.description: Novel, potent agonists of the apelin receptor APJ, including both oral small-molecule and parenteral (subcutaneous) antibody-based programs, developed as exercise mimetic therapies for obesity and metabolic diseases. These are produced via pharmaceutical R&D and delivered as oral or injectable drugs, requiring regulated clinical development and manufacturing.

products.name: Platform-Derived Therapeutics for Metabolic Aging (Discovery Stage)
products.description: Early-stage drug discovery programs targeting novel biological pathways identified through proprietary human aging datasets and multi-omic profiling, focused on developing new therapeutics for chronic metabolic diseases. These programs are advanced internally and through collaborations, with the intent to produce regulated pharmaceutical products.

products.name: Spacecraft Platforms
products.description: Redwire designs, manufactures, and delivers a portfolio of next-generation spacecraft platforms (SabreSat, Phantom, Hammerhead, Thresher, Mako) for various orbits, supporting civil, national security, and commercial missions. These are physically manufactured, flight-proven systems tailored for rapid deployment and mission flexibility.

products.name: Space Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Redwire provides large space infrastructure products, including solar array power generation systems (e.g., Roll-Out Solar Array), docking mechanisms (e.g., International Berthing and Docking Mechanism), and other foundational components for complex space missions. These are engineered and manufactured physical systems for spacecraft and space stations.

products.name: Microgravity Research and Manufacturing Services
products.description: Redwire develops and operates microgravity payload facilities and offers services for in-space research and manufacturing, including biotechnology, pharmaceutical crystal growth (PIL-BOX), and advanced materials. These services are delivered via physical payloads and facilities on the ISS and other platforms, enabling unique research and production in microgravity.

products.name: Lunar Surface Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Redwire is developing lunar surface infrastructure, such as shielding structures, landing pads, roads, and habitat foundations, to support long-term human presence on the Moon and Mars. These are physically constructed systems intended for deployment on extraterrestrial surfaces.

products.name: Uncrewed Aerial Systems (UAS)
products.description: Redwire designs, manufactures, and supports combat-proven uncrewed aerial systems (Stalker and Penguin series) for military, commercial, and civil customers. These are physically manufactured aircraft with modular payload capabilities, supporting intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, and rapid deployment missions.

products.name: ISR and Optical Sensor Payloads
products.description: Redwire manufactures and supplies intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) payloads, including the Octopus line of optical gimbal camera systems for airborne and space applications. These are ruggedized, high-definition imaging systems integrated into crewed and uncrewed vehicles.

products.name: Space Sensors and Avionics
products.description: Redwire develops and supplies space-qualified sensors (e.g., star trackers, sun sensors) and avionics systems (e.g., power distribution, RF front ends, on-board computing) for spacecraft navigation, control, and mission operations. These are specialized, physically manufactured components for space environments.

products.name: Satellite Payloads and RF Communications Systems
products.description: Redwire designs and delivers satellite payloads for sensing, imaging, positioning, navigation, timing, and radio frequency (RF) communications, including Link-16 compatible RF systems. These are engineered payloads integrated into satellites for defense and commercial applications.

products.name: Digital Engineering and Simulation Software
products.description: Redwire offers proprietary enterprise software for digital engineering, modeling, and simulation of space architectures, spacecraft, and mission scenarios. This is a cloud-based digital product enabling mission design, trade analysis, and optimization for customers.

products.name: Gold
products.description: Gold is produced through open-pit mining and processed using heap leaching, milling, and pressure oxidation (POX) methods at the Hycroft Mine. The product is sold as a commodity to external customers in the form of bullion or doré bars.

products.name: Silver
products.description: Silver is extracted alongside gold at the Hycroft Mine using similar open-pit mining and processing techniques, including heap leaching and milling. The silver is sold as a commodity to external customers, typically in bullion or doré form.

products.name: AI- and AR-Enabled Smart Glasses
products.description: Wearable computing devices in eyewear-style form factors, integrating waveguide optics, microdisplays, cameras, sensors, and onboard processing to deliver hands-free access to digital content, AR overlays, and enterprise applications. Manufactured in-house and through contract partners, sold under Vuzix and white-label brands.

products.name: Waveguide Optics and Display Engines
products.description: Proprietary optical components and compact display engines designed for integration into smart glasses and wearable displays, sold both as components for Vuzix-branded products and to ODM/OEM partners for third-party device integration. Manufactured in dedicated cleanroom facilities.

products.name: Engineering Services and ODM/OEM Component Solutions
products.description: Custom engineering, prototyping, and technical consulting services for ODM/OEM partners seeking to integrate Vuzix waveguide optics and wearable display technologies into their own products, including support from prototype development to production.

products.name: Smart Glasses Software Applications and App Store
products.description: Standard and third-party software applications for Vuzix smart glasses, distributed via device-installed software and the Vuzix App Store, including productivity, collaboration, and workflow tools. Revenue generated through app sales and subscriptions.

products.name: Mobilium Logistics Mobility Software
products.description: A logistics mobility software platform (acquired via Moviynt) that supports smart glasses and handheld devices in warehousing and manufacturing, providing SAP-certified ERP integration and device-agnostic mobile apps for logistics transactions without middleware.

products.name: Life Sciences Research Reagents and Assays
products.description: A comprehensive portfolio of reagents, assay kits, antibodies, recombinant proteins, and cell lines used in cell, gene, and protein research, drug discovery, and development. These products are manufactured in-house and delivered as physical consumables to research labs, biotech, pharma, and academic institutions.

products.name: Life Sciences Research Instruments and Automation
products.description: A suite of laboratory instruments including imaging systems, plate readers, cell counters, cytometers, automated liquid handlers, and sample preparation platforms, designed and manufactured for high-throughput and high-content analysis in life sciences research and drug development.

products.name: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Software Solutions
products.description: A portfolio of digital software platforms for laboratory data management, image analysis, electronic lab notebooks, experiment design, and clinical data analytics, delivered as cloud-based or on-premise solutions to research and clinical customers.

products.name: Genomics and Multi-Omics Solutions
products.description: Products and services supporting genomics and multi-omics workflows, including next-generation sequencing (NGS) library prep kits, gene editing and modulation technologies, and multi-omic analysis reagents and software, delivered as physical kits and digital tools to research and clinical labs.

products.name: Preclinical and Drug Discovery Services
products.description: Contract research and preclinical services including cell panel screening, cell line engineering, functional genomic screening, and immune cell screening, provided to pharmaceutical, biotech, and academic customers to accelerate drug development.

products.name: Technology Platforms and Licensing for Biotherapeutics
products.description: Proprietary technology platforms and licensing offerings such as CHOSOURCE® expression system, Pin-point® base editing, and gene delivery services, enabling customers to develop and manufacture biotherapeutics and cell/gene therapies. Delivered as technology access, licensing, and custom services.

products.name: Reproductive and Newborn Health Diagnostics
products.description: Instruments, reagents, assay platforms, and software for prenatal, maternal, and newborn screening, including genetic, metabolic, and chromosomal disorder detection. Delivered as physical kits, automated instruments, and cloud-based informatics to hospitals, labs, and clinics.

products.name: Genetic and Genomic Clinical Testing Services
products.description: Clinical laboratory services offering multi-omic, whole genome, exome, and gene panel testing for inherited and acquired diseases, provided through a global laboratory network to healthcare providers and patients. Includes data analysis and reporting software.

products.name: Umbilical Cord Blood Banking Services
products.description: ViaCord® services for the collection, processing, and long-term storage of umbilical cord blood and tissue stem cells for potential therapeutic use in transplantation and regenerative medicine. Delivered as a service to expectant parents and healthcare providers.

products.name: Immunodiagnostics and Infectious Disease Testing
products.description: A broad portfolio of immunodiagnostic instruments, reagents, and assay platforms for the detection of infectious diseases, autoimmune disorders, allergies, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Delivered as physical kits, automated systems, and software to clinical labs and hospitals.

products.name: Home and Kitchen Appliances
products.description: A range of small appliances for home and kitchen use, manufactured by third-party suppliers and sold primarily through online marketplaces such as Amazon. Products are delivered directly to consumers via e-commerce fulfillment networks.

products.name: Kitchenware
products.description: Various kitchenware products, including utensils and accessories, sourced from third-party manufacturers and sold under owned brands through online retail channels.

products.name: Air Quality Appliances
products.description: Appliances designed to improve indoor air quality, such as air purifiers and humidifiers, manufactured by third-party suppliers and sold online to consumers, with sales peaking in the summer season.

products.name: Health and Beauty Products
products.description: A variety of health and beauty products, including personal care items, sourced from third-party suppliers and sold under owned brands via e-commerce platforms.

products.name: Essential Oils
products.description: Bottled essential oils and related aromatherapy products, manufactured by third-party suppliers and sold under owned brands, primarily through online marketplaces.

products.name: Photo Paper and Printing Supplies
products.description: Photo paper and related printing supplies, sold under the Photo Paper Direct (PPD) brand, sourced from third-party suppliers and distributed via online channels.

products.name: Land-Based Casino and Resort Operations
products.description: Operation of 20 land-based casinos, including gaming, hotel accommodations, restaurants, entertainment, and other amenities, delivered through physical properties in the US and UK, requiring significant physical infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Online iGaming and Casino Platforms
products.description: Provision of digital casino gaming experiences, including slots, table games, and exclusive content, delivered via proprietary and third-party online platforms to consumers in regulated jurisdictions.

products.name: Sports Betting (Retail and Online)
products.description: Sportsbook services offered both at physical casino locations and through digital platforms, allowing customers to place bets on sporting events; requires regulatory licensing and technology infrastructure.

products.name: Lottery Systems and Services (B2B and B2C)
products.description: Development, management, and operation of lottery systems and services for government and private clients (B2B), as well as direct-to-consumer lottery offerings (B2C), including technology platforms, retail terminals, and monitoring systems, delivered under long-term contracts in multiple jurisdictions.

products.name: Online Bingo Platforms
products.description: Operation of digital bingo platforms under various brands, providing online bingo games to consumers in regulated markets, delivered via proprietary and licensed software.

products.name: Free-to-Play Games and Audience Engagement Solutions
products.description: Provision of free-to-play digital games and real-time audience engagement solutions for live events and interactive livestreams, delivered via online platforms and mobile applications.

products.name: Casino and Resort Development Projects
products.description: Development and construction of new integrated casino resorts and entertainment complexes, including large-scale projects in Las Vegas, Chicago, and New York, involving real estate development, regulatory approvals, and significant capital investment.

products.name: Commercial Service Robots
products.description: Robotic systems designed, manufactured, and deployed for automating customer-facing tasks in commercial environments such as restaurants, hotels, casinos, senior living homes, and movie theaters. Includes the Matradee line (food delivery, bussing, hosting), ADAM (AI-powered beverage preparation), and Scorpion (compact AI bartender). Delivered as physical robots with proprietary AI, often under a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

products.name: Industrial Robotic Solutions
products.description: Robotic platforms engineered for production, manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, and automotive environments. Includes Titan (heavy-duty autonomous mobile delivery robots), DUST-E (autonomous cleaning robots for commercial and industrial spaces), and Dex (humanoid robot for material handling, machine tending, and quality inspection). Delivered as physical robots with advanced AI, often via RaaS.

products.name: Robotic Data Services
products.description: Provision of data generation, collection, and standardization services for embodied AI training. Involves designing task environments, operating robots, and producing high-value datasets for AI model development, offered to external partners and customers. Delivered as digital data and services anchored in the U.S.

products.name: Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS)
products.description: Subscription-based offering where customers access robotic hardware, AI software, and support services for a monthly fee over a contracted term. Covers deployment, maintenance, and warranty, reducing upfront costs and providing recurring revenue. Applies to both commercial and industrial robots.

products.name: Robotic Restaurant Operations
products.description: Operation and franchising of robotics-based restaurants, utilizing proprietary robots (e.g., ADAM and Scorpion) for food and beverage preparation and service. Delivered through company-owned and franchise-operated locations, managed by a subsidiary, generating recurring revenue from restaurant operations.

products.name: CAB Antibody-Based Therapeutics for Solid Tumor Cancers
products.description: A pipeline of conditionally active biologics (CABs), including monoclonal antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), bispecific antibodies, and CAR-T cells, designed to selectively target tumor antigens in the acidic tumor microenvironment. These are developed using proprietary protein engineering and are delivered as injectable biologic drugs, manufactured via mammalian cell lines and contract manufacturing organizations.

products.name: CAB Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs)
products.description: Antibody-drug conjugates using CAB antibodies linked to cytotoxic payloads (e.g., MMAE), designed to deliver toxins selectively to tumor cells in acidic microenvironments, reducing off-target toxicity. These are manufactured using proprietary linker technology and delivered as injectable biologics.

products.name: CAB Bispecific Antibodies (T Cell Engagers)
products.description: Bispecific antibodies engineered with CAB technology to simultaneously bind tumor antigens and T cell receptors (e.g., CD3), activating T cells only in the tumor microenvironment. These are produced via mammalian cell expression and delivered as injectable biologics.

products.name: CAB Monoclonal Antibodies for Immuno-Oncology
products.description: Monoclonal antibodies developed with CAB technology to target immune checkpoints (e.g., CTLA-4) or tumor antigens, designed to enhance anti-tumor immune responses with reduced systemic toxicity. These are manufactured as biologic drugs for injection.

products.name: CAB Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Cells (CAR-T)
products.description: Engineered T cells expressing CAB-based chimeric antigen receptors, designed to selectively target tumor antigens in acidic microenvironments, potentially reducing off-tumor toxicity. These are manufactured using cell engineering and expansion processes.

products.name: CAB Antibody-Based Companion Diagnostics
products.description: Companion diagnostic tests developed in partnership with third parties to identify patients most likely to benefit from CAB antibody-based therapies, using proprietary antibody technology and manufactured by diagnostic partners.

products.name: Infrastructure Investment Management
products.description: Management of client capital in infrastructure assets and businesses, including utilities, transport, midstream, and data infrastructure, through private funds, permanent capital vehicles, and listed platforms. Investments are made in physical assets such as pipelines, transmission lines, rail, toll roads, terminals, telecom towers, fiber, and data centers, requiring significant operational expertise and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Renewable Power and Transition Investment Management
products.description: Management of client capital in renewable power and energy transition assets, including hydroelectric, solar, wind, distributed energy, storage, and sustainable solutions such as carbon capture and renewable fuels. Delivered through private funds, listed platforms, and perpetual strategies, these investments require physical asset development, operation, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Private Equity Investment Management
products.description: Management of client capital in private equity investments across business services and industrials, including control and non-control investments, special situations, financial infrastructure, and venture capital. Delivered via private funds, listed vehicles, and evergreen funds, these investments involve acquiring, operating, and improving businesses globally.

products.name: Real Estate Investment Management
products.description: Management of client capital in real estate assets, including retail, multifamily, logistics, office, hospitality, land, and alternative living sectors. Delivered through private funds, listed and non-traded REITs, and perpetual vehicles, these investments require physical asset acquisition, development, and management across global markets.

products.name: Credit Investment Management
products.description: Management of client capital in credit strategies, including private credit, direct lending, opportunistic, structured, and liquid credit, across sectors such as infrastructure, real estate, corporate, consumer, and specialty finance. Delivered through private funds, managed accounts, and partnerships with leading credit managers, these strategies involve underwriting, structuring, and managing debt investments.

products.name: AI Infrastructure Investment Management
products.description: Management of client capital in the development and operation of AI infrastructure, including data centers, data transfer, chip storage, and energy generation assets. Delivered through dedicated funds and large-scale investment programs, these investments require physical infrastructure development and partnerships with technology and government entities.

products.name: Offshore Support Vessel Services
products.description: Provision of marine and transportation services using a diversified fleet of offshore service vessels (OSVs), including Anchor Handling Towing Supply Vessels (AHTS), Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs), crew boats, utility vessels, and offshore tugs. These vessels are physically operated and chartered to customers to support all phases of offshore oil and gas and windfarm exploration, development, production, maintenance, and abandonment activities worldwide.

products.name: Generic Pharmaceutical Products
products.description: Bioequivalent versions of brand-name drugs, developed and manufactured using formulation and drug delivery expertise, sold primarily as solid oral and alternative dosage forms through various sales channels to wholesalers, retailers, and third-party partners.

products.name: Branded Pharmaceutical Products for CNS Disorders and Specialty Segments
products.description: Proprietary, internally developed or licensed branded drugs, primarily for central nervous system (CNS) disorders and select specialty indications, marketed through a specialty sales force to healthcare professionals.

products.name: Authorized Generic Pharmaceutical Products
products.description: Authorized generic versions of branded drugs, produced under license from brand owners and sold under the company’s label, leveraging existing brand formulations and regulatory approvals.

products.name: Specialty Generic Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Generic drugs with complex formulations, special handling requirements, or difficult raw material sourcing, often developed through alliances and manufactured by partners, marketed for niche or hard-to-replicate indications.

products.name: Branded Pharmaceutical Products for Infectious Diseases and Other Indications
products.description: Branded drugs for non-CNS specialty indications, such as Emverm® (mebendazole) for parasitic infections, acquired or licensed and marketed to healthcare providers.

products.name: Equities Investment Management
products.description: Management of equity investment strategies across global, regional, and sector-specific mandates, delivered through actively managed funds and accounts. Involves fundamental research and bottom-up stock selection by specialized teams.

products.name: Fixed Income Investment Management
products.description: Management of fixed income portfolios using a variety of techniques and mandates, including global unconstrained and regionally focused strategies, delivered through funds and accounts. Involves credit analysis and risk management by specialized teams.

products.name: Multi-Asset Investment Management
products.description: Management of portfolios that combine multiple asset classes, including balanced, income, and adaptive asset allocation strategies, delivered through funds and accounts. Involves strategic and tactical allocation by dedicated teams.

products.name: Alternatives Investment Management
products.description: Management of alternative investment strategies, including global multi-strategy, managed futures, risk premia, commodities, private credit, and long/short equity, delivered through specialized funds and vehicles. Involves cross-asset class expertise and complex risk management.

products.name: Pooled Investment Vehicles (Mutual Funds, ETFs, OEICs, SICAVs, CITs, UCITS, Hedge Funds, Closed-End Funds)
products.description: Creation and management of pooled investment vehicles across multiple structures and jurisdictions, including mutual funds, ETFs, OEICs, SICAVs, CITs, UCITS, hedge funds, and closed-end funds. These vehicles are offered to retail and institutional clients globally.

products.name: Separately Managed Accounts (SMAs) and Segregated Mandates
products.description: Provision of customized investment management services through separately managed accounts and segregated mandates tailored to institutional and high-net-worth clients. Involves direct portfolio management according to client-specific guidelines.

products.name: Sportsbook (Online and Retail Sports Betting)
products.description: A digital and retail platform allowing users to place bets on sports events at fixed odds, with DraftKings setting the odds and managing payouts. Delivered via proprietary software and mobile/web apps, and also through physical sportsbook locations, requiring regulatory licenses in each jurisdiction.

products.name: iGaming (Online Casino)
products.description: A digital casino platform offering games such as blackjack, roulette, baccarat, and slot machines, delivered via proprietary and licensed software through mobile and web applications. Revenue is generated as users play against the house, with content sourced both in-house and from third-party suppliers.

products.name: Daily Fantasy Sports (DFS)
products.description: A peer-to-peer digital platform where users compete in fantasy sports contests for prize money, with DraftKings providing the contest setup, scoring, prize distribution, and administrative technology. Delivered via mobile and web applications, available in most U.S. states and certain Canadian provinces.

products.name: Digital Lottery Courier
products.description: A digital service that facilitates the purchase of official state lottery tickets on behalf of customers through a mobile application or website, earning revenue from service fees and commissions on ticket sales and winnings. Acts solely as a courier without assuming risk from game outcomes.

products.name: Prediction Markets
products.description: A digital platform and standalone app allowing eligible customers to trade on real-world outcomes (including sports and financial markets), with DraftKings acting as an introducing broker and earning fees from customer trades. Regulated as a designated contract market and introducing broker under CFTC oversight.

products.name: New Vehicle Sales
products.description: Sale of new cars and light trucks from 24 different brands through franchised dealerships, requiring physical inventory, manufacturer relationships, and in-person sales processes.

products.name: Used Vehicle Sales
products.description: Sale of used cars and light trucks through both franchised dealerships and EchoPark specialty retail locations, involving acquisition from consumers, auctions, and other dealers, with both in-person and omnichannel sales.

products.name: Powersports Vehicle Sales
products.description: Sale of new and used powersports vehicles such as motorcycles, personal watercraft, and all-terrain vehicles through dedicated dealerships and retail outlets, requiring specialized inventory and manufacturer relationships.

products.name: Parts, Service, and Collision Repair (Fixed Operations)
products.description: Provision of vehicle maintenance, manufacturer warranty repairs, paint and collision repair, and sale of replacement parts at franchised dealerships and powersports locations, requiring physical facilities, trained technicians, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Finance, Insurance, and Other Aftermarket Products (F&I)
products.description: Arrangement and sale of third-party financing, extended warranties, service contracts, insurance, and other aftermarket products for vehicle buyers, earning commissions and fees, delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: HEPLISAV-B Hepatitis B Vaccine
products.description: A recombinant, adjuvanted hepatitis B vaccine for adults, manufactured using proprietary CpG 1018 adjuvant and recombinant hepatitis B surface antigen, produced at the company's facility and distributed globally. Delivered as a two-dose regimen over one month.

products.name: CpG 1018 Vaccine Adjuvant Supply
products.description: Proprietary synthetic oligonucleotide adjuvant (CpG 1018) supplied to third-party organizations for use in their vaccine development and manufacturing, under commercial supply agreements and research collaborations. Manufactured using regulated processes and supplied at commercial scale.

products.name: Shingles Vaccine Candidate (Z-1018)
products.description: An investigational vaccine for the prevention of shingles in adults, leveraging the CpG 1018 adjuvant and glycoprotein E antigen, currently in clinical development. Manufactured using proprietary adjuvant technology and delivered as a two-dose regimen.

products.name: Plague Vaccine Candidate (rF1V + CpG 1018)
products.description: A recombinant plague vaccine candidate adjuvanted with CpG 1018, developed in collaboration with and funded by the U.S. Department of Defense, currently in Phase 2 clinical trials. Manufactured using recombinant technology and proprietary adjuvant platform.

products.name: Hemp-Derived THC Beverages
products.description: Ready-to-drink beverages infused with hemp-derived THC, produced using premium natural ingredients and manufactured by third-party co-manufacturers, distributed through retailers, online, and direct-to-retail partnerships.

products.name: Hemp-Derived Edible Products
products.description: Edible products infused with hemp-derived THC, including gummies and other formats, produced by third-party co-manufacturers and sold primarily online and through direct-to-retail partnerships under brands such as incredibles and Beboe.

products.name: Brand Licensing for Hemp-Derived Products
products.description: Licensing of intellectual property and brand rights (including RYTHM, incredibles, Beboe, Dogwalkers, Doctor Solomon’s, &Shine, Good Green, and Señorita) to third parties for use in manufacturing and distributing hemp-derived THC products, generating recurring licensing revenue.

products.name: (Discontinued) Cannabis Extraction Equipment and Solutions
products.description: Previously, the company sold proprietary extraction equipment and solutions (hydrocarbon, alcohol, solventless, post-processing, and lab equipment) to licensed cannabis and hemp cultivators and processors, manufactured under acquired brands and used in indoor processing facilities.

products.name: (Discontinued) Vertical Farming Units and Cultivation Software
products.description: Previously, the company sold proprietary micro-environment-controlled vertical farming units (VFUs) and associated SaaS cultivation software (Agrify Insights™) to licensed cannabis cultivators, enabling modular, climate-controlled indoor farming.

products.name: Health Insurance Products
products.description: Comprehensive health insurance plans including commercial medical, dental, behavioral health, vision, Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, CHIP, and dual-eligible plans. These are delivered through risk-bearing insurance contracts or administrative services, requiring regulatory compliance, actuarial pricing, and provider network management.

products.name: Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) Solutions
products.description: Administration and management of prescription drug benefits for health plans and employers, including plan design, formulary management, retail pharmacy network management, specialty and mail order pharmacy services, and clinical programs. Delivered via proprietary technology platforms and extensive pharmacy networks.

products.name: Retail Pharmacy Services
products.description: Dispensing prescription medications and providing pharmacy patient care programs, vaccination administration, and medication management at approximately 9,000 CVS Pharmacy retail locations and online. Requires licensed pharmacists, regulated infrastructure, and integration with PBMs and health plans.

products.name: Specialty and Mail Order Pharmacy Services
products.description: Provision of specialty medications for complex and chronic conditions and mail order pharmacy services for maintenance medications, delivered via specialty pharmacies, mail order facilities, and digital channels. Involves advanced logistics, clinical support, and regulatory accreditation.

products.name: Primary Care and Retail Clinic Services
products.description: In-person and virtual primary care and walk-in clinic services provided through Oak Street Health centers and MinuteClinic locations, staffed by medical professionals. Delivered in community-based centers and retail clinics, supported by proprietary clinical workflow technology and digital scheduling.

products.name: In-Home Health Evaluations and Diagnostic Services
products.description: In-home and virtual health risk assessments, diagnostic screenings, and medication reviews performed by credentialed providers, primarily for Medicare Advantage health plans. Delivered via a mobile provider network and proprietary clinical workflow software.

products.name: Consumer Health and Wellness Products
products.description: Retail sales of over-the-counter drugs, consumer health products, beauty, personal care, and general merchandise, including proprietary brand products, through CVS Pharmacy stores and online. Requires supply chain management and retail operations.

products.name: Vaccination and Ancillary Pharmacy Services
products.description: Administration of vaccinations and ancillary pharmacy services such as medication counseling and patient care programs at retail pharmacy locations. Delivered by licensed pharmacists and supported by digital scheduling and clinical workflow tools.

products.name: Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) Services
products.description: Negotiation of pharmaceutical purchasing and rebate contracts on behalf of participants, including administrative, management, and reporting services for pharmaceutical manufacturers. Delivered through a dedicated group purchasing organization entity.

products.name: Biosimilar Commercialization and Co-Production
products.description: Commercialization and co-production of biosimilar pharmaceutical products through the Cordavis subsidiary, working directly with manufacturers to increase access and competition in the U.S. market. Involves pharmaceutical development, regulatory compliance, and supply chain management.

products.name: Revuforj (revumenib)
products.description: An oral, first-in-class menin inhibitor manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as a pharmaceutical product for the treatment of relapsed or refractory acute leukemia with KMT2A translocation and acute myeloid leukemia with NPM1 mutation. Commercially distributed in the U.S. and potentially internationally.

products.name: Niktimvo (axatilimab-csfr)
products.description: A first-in-class monoclonal antibody (biologic) targeting CSF-1R, manufactured using biologic processes, for the treatment of chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD) after failure of at least two prior lines of systemic therapy. Commercialized in the U.S. in partnership with Incyte.

products.name: Entinostat (out-licensed in Asia)
products.description: An oral, small molecule product candidate with direct effects on cancer and immune regulatory cells, manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as a pharmaceutical product. Commercial rights are out-licensed to Eddingpharm for China and certain Asian countries, with marketing approval in China.

products.name: Engineered Polymers and Compounds
products.description: A broad portfolio of high-performance engineered polymers and compounds, including nylon, polyoxymethylene (POM), liquid crystal polymers (LCP), long-fiber reinforced thermoplastics (LFRT), polypropylene compounds, thermoplastic elastomers (TPE), thermoplastic polyesters, thermoplastic vulcanizates (TPV), and ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMW-PE). These are manufactured through polymerization and compounding at global facilities and delivered to OEMs and suppliers for use in automotive, electronics, medical, industrial, and consumer applications.

products.name: Acetyl Intermediates and Derivatives
products.description: Production and sale of acetyl products such as acetic acid, acetic anhydride, vinyl acetate monomer (VAM), acetate esters (ethyl acetate, butyl acetate), and formaldehyde. These are manufactured in large-scale chemical plants and serve as key intermediates for paints, coatings, adhesives, pharmaceuticals, and other industrial uses.

products.name: Emulsion Polymers
products.description: Manufacture of vinyl acetate-based and acrylate-based emulsion polymers, including vinyl acetate ethylene (VAE) emulsions, used in water-based paints, coatings, adhesives, construction, glass fiber, textiles, and paper. Produced in specialized reactors and sold under various brands globally.

products.name: EVA Polymers and Compounds
products.description: Production of ethylene vinyl acetate (EVA) resins and compounds, as well as select grades of low-density polyethylene resins, manufactured in high-pressure reactors. These are used in flexible packaging films, lamination products, adhesives, automotive parts, and carpeting.

products.name: Redispersible Polymer Powders (RDP)
products.description: Manufacture of redispersible polymer powders from polymer emulsions, converted into powdered thermoplastic resin materials for use in construction mortars, plasters, renders, tile adhesives, and self-leveling floor systems. Produced in dedicated facilities and sold globally under the Elotex® brand.

products.name: Acetate Tow and Acetate Flake
products.description: Production of acetate tow and acetate flake, primarily used in cigarette filters. Acetate flake is produced from wood pulp and acetic acid/anhydride, then further processed into acetate tow in specialized fiber facilities.

products.name: Solvents and Chemical Derivatives
products.description: Manufacture and sale of solvents (ethyl acetate, butyl acetate) and chemical derivatives (formaldehyde, paraformaldehyde) used in coatings, inks, adhesives, pharmaceuticals, and as intermediates for other chemical products. Produced as part of the acetyl chain operations.

products.name: Polyester Films
products.description: Production of PET polyester films (Mylar®, Melinex®) used in consumer, industrial, healthcare, and electronics applications. Manufactured in film extrusion and coating facilities, these films offer a wide range of performance capabilities.

products.name: Specialty Sweeteners and Preservatives
products.description: Production of acesulfame potassium (Ace-K) and sorbates, used as sweeteners and preservatives in food, beverages, personal care, pet food, household cleaning, and pharmaceutical products. Manufactured by affiliate Nutrinova Netherlands B.V.

products.name: Filament Products
products.description: Production and sale of nylon and PBT-based filament products used in personal care, construction, and industrial end-markets. Manufactured in joint venture facilities with extrusion and spinning technology.

products.name: Plug and Play Power-Plug & Receptacle Systems
products.description: Universal and smart plug-and-play power-plug and receptacle systems for safe, quick installation of light fixtures, ceiling fans, and other hardwired electrical products, manufactured using patented technology and sold as retrofit kits or embedded in products.

products.name: Smart Plug and Play Ceiling Fans
products.description: High-end smart ceiling fans with plug-and-play installation, advanced safety and smart features, controlled via proprietary app or voice, manufactured and sold directly or through e-commerce.

products.name: Smart Plug and Play Lighting Fixtures
products.description: Smart light fixtures with plug-and-play installation, advanced safety and smart features, controlled via proprietary app or voice, manufactured and sold directly or through e-commerce.

products.name: Smart Sky Platform (All-in-One Smart Home Platform)
products.description: All-in-one smart home platform integrating safety, security, and smart features (e.g., smoke/carbon monoxide detection, sensors, WiFi extender, emergency backup) into a single ceiling-mounted unit, controlled via app or voice, designed for easy installation in new or existing buildings.

products.name: SkyHome App and Smart Home Control Software
products.description: Proprietary mobile application and software platform for controlling Sky Technologies' smart products and integrated third-party smart home devices, enabling scheduling, energy management, security, and other smart features via WiFi, BLE, and voice assistants.

products.name: E-Commerce Retail of Home Lighting, Ceiling Fans, and Home Furnishings
products.description: Online retail and e-commerce sales of home lighting, ceiling fans, and other home furnishings through acquired platforms and websites, serving retail customers, builders, and professionals.

products.name: Third-Party Home Electrical Products (Resale)
products.description: Resale of third-party home electrical products such as ceiling fans, heaters, and light fixtures, often paired with Sky Technologies' plug-and-play technology or adaptive kits, through e-commerce and distribution channels.

products.name: Smart Home Monitoring and Subscription Services (Planned)
products.description: Planned subscription-based services for smart home monitoring, including communications, fire alarms, intrusion alerts, emergency response, and environmental hazard monitoring, delivered via the Smart Sky Platform and associated software.

products.name: Licensing of Plug and Play and Smart Home Technologies
products.description: Licensing of proprietary plug-and-play and smart home technologies, including country marketing rights and technology royalties, to third parties and OEMs globally.

products.name: Hoists
products.description: Manufacture and sale of a wide variety of electric, air-powered, lever, and hand hoists, winches, and hoist trolleys for lifting and moving materials. Products are produced in-house and sold through distributors and directly to end-users for industrial, construction, energy, and entertainment applications.

products.name: High-Precision Conveying Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and integration of modular and custom-engineered conveyor systems, including asynchronous and accumulation systems, for automated material transport in industrial, life sciences, food, and e-commerce sectors. Delivered as physical systems with advanced automation features.

products.name: Digital Power Control and Delivery Systems
products.description: Development and supply of AC and DC drive systems, radio remote controls, brakes, collision avoidance, and power delivery subsystems for overhead material handling and mining equipment. Products are manufactured and often combined with engineered services for complete solutions.

products.name: Actuators and Rotary Unions
products.description: Design and manufacture of mechanical and electromechanical actuators and rotary unions for linear and rotary motion in industrial applications. Products are manufactured and sold to OEMs and end-users in transportation, energy, and manufacturing sectors.

products.name: Chain and Rigging Tools
products.description: Manufacture and sale of alloy and carbon steel chain, forged attachments (hooks, shackles, clamps), textile slings, and load binders for lifting, securing, and rigging applications. Products are produced in-house and distributed to industrial, construction, and consumer markets.

products.name: Industrial Cranes
products.description: Manufacture and marketing of overhead aluminum light rail workstations, crane components, and crane kits for industrial and automotive applications. Products are manufactured and sold under recognized brands to OEMs and end-users.

products.name: Elevator Application Drive Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and support of elevator-specific drive products and subsystems for high-rise and high-speed elevators, including AC and DC drives and regenerative controls. Products are manufactured and sold mainly to elevator OEMs.

products.name: Prestressed Concrete Strand (PC Strand)
products.description: High-strength, seven-wire steel strand manufactured for use as reinforcement in precast and posttensioned concrete elements and structures. Produced in specialized manufacturing facilities using high-carbon steel wire rod and delivered primarily to manufacturers of concrete products for nonresidential and residential construction.

products.name: Welded Wire Reinforcement (WWR)
products.description: Steel wire reinforcement products, including engineered and standard welded wire mesh, manufactured from low-carbon steel wire rod for use as primary or secondary reinforcement in concrete construction. Includes engineered structural mesh (ESM), concrete pipe reinforcement (CPR), and standard welded wire reinforcement (SWWR), produced in U.S. manufacturing facilities and supplied to concrete product manufacturers and contractors.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: The company owns and operates commercial real estate properties, generating revenue by leasing space to external tenants. This business line requires property management, maintenance, and compliance with real estate regulations.

products.name: ZYNLONTA (loncastuximab tesirine-lpyl)
products.description: ZYNLONTA is a CD19-directed antibody drug conjugate (ADC) manufactured using complex biologic processes and distributed as an injectable therapy. It is delivered to healthcare providers and hospitals for the treatment of relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) and is being developed for use in earlier lines of DLBCL and other B-cell lymphomas, both as a monotherapy and in combination with other agents.

products.name: PSMA-targeting ADC (ADCT-241)
products.description: ADCT-241 is a next-generation antibody drug conjugate targeting prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA), utilizing an exatecan-based payload with a novel hydrophilic linker. It is in pre-clinical development for the treatment of metastatic castrate resistant prostate cancer and is produced using advanced biologic and chemical manufacturing processes.

products.name: Antibody-Based Therapeutics (including Bispecific and Trispecific Antibodies)
products.description: Therapeutic biologics developed using proprietary protein engineering platforms (Azymetric, EFECT, ProTECT) to create mono-, bi-, and trispecific antibodies for the treatment of cancer, inflammation, and autoimmune diseases. These are manufactured using standard monoclonal antibody processes and delivered via injection or infusion.

products.name: Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs)
products.description: Engineered biologic drugs that combine monoclonal antibodies with proprietary cytotoxin payloads (e.g., TOPO1i) and linkers to deliver targeted cytotoxic therapy to cancer cells. ADCs are manufactured using specialized conjugation and fill-finish processes and administered to patients via injection or infusion.

products.name: Out-Licensing of Therapeutic Platform Technologies
products.description: Licensing of proprietary therapeutic platforms (Azymetric, EFECT, drug conjugate platforms) to pharmaceutical partners for their own drug discovery and development. Revenue is generated through upfront payments, milestones, and royalties. Delivery is digital/knowledge transfer and ongoing support.

products.name: Royalty and Milestone Revenue from Licensed Products
products.description: Collection of milestone payments and ongoing royalties from commercial partners (e.g., Jazz, BeOne, J&J, BMS, GSK, Daiichi Sankyo, Merck) for the development and commercialization of Zymeworks-originated therapeutics, such as zanidatamab (Ziihera) and pasritamig. Revenue is financial and based on product sales and regulatory achievements.

products.name: Zanidatamab (Ziihera)
products.description: A bispecific antibody therapeutic targeting HER2-expressing tumors, developed using the Azymetric platform, and commercialized through partners for indications including biliary tract cancer and gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma. Manufactured as a biologic and delivered via infusion.

products.name: Pasritamig (JNJ-78278343)
products.description: A first-in-class bispecific T cell engager targeting KLK2 for castration resistant prostate cancer, engineered using the Azymetric platform and developed by J&J. Manufactured as a biologic and delivered via infusion.

products.name: Clinical-Stage and Preclinical Oncology and Autoimmune Therapeutics (ZW191, ZW251, ZW220, ZW209, ZW1528)
products.description: A pipeline of proprietary antibody-based and ADC therapeutics targeting specific cancer and autoimmune disease markers (e.g., FRα, GPC3, NaPi2b, DLL3, IL-4R⍺/IL-33), developed using Zymeworks’ platforms. These are in various stages of clinical and preclinical development and are manufactured as biologics or ADCs.

products.name: Ivonescimab Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Ivonescimab is a novel, bispecific antibody therapeutic developed and commercialized for the treatment of various solid tumors, primarily non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and colorectal cancer (CRC). It is produced using Akeso’s Tetrabody technology and delivered as a biologic drug, either as monotherapy or in combination with chemotherapy, through regulated clinical and commercial supply chains.

products.name: Kitchenware
products.description: A broad range of kitchen tools, cutlery, kitchen scales, thermometers, cutting boards, shears, cookware, pantryware, spice racks, and bakeware, primarily sourced from third-party manufacturers and sold under various owned and licensed brands through retailers and online channels.

products.name: Tableware
products.description: Dinnerware, stemware, flatware, and giftware products designed for serving and consuming food, manufactured or sourced globally and sold under multiple brands to retailers and consumers.

products.name: Home Solutions Products
products.description: A variety of home products including thermal beverageware, bath scales, weather and outdoor household products, food storage, neoprene travel products, and home décor, sourced from global suppliers and sold under several brands.

products.name: Sterling Silver Products
products.description: Sterling silver products manufactured at a leased facility in Puerto Rico, primarily for tableware and giftware applications, distributed through the company's retail channels.

products.name: Spice Racks and Filled Spice Canisters
products.description: Spice racks and canisters filled with spices, assembled and filled at a company-owned facility in Massachusetts, sold as part of kitchenware offerings.
